newsitem.title: USA: Gore adds stops in Japan, S. Korea to China trip.
newsitem.headline: Gore adds stops in Japan, S. Korea to China trip.

text.p: Vice President Al Gore has added visits to Japan and South Korea this month during his previously scheduled trip to China for talks on improving U.S.-Sino relations, the White House announced on Tuesday.

"The vice president will meet with the leaders of the three countries to discuss international, regional and bilateral issues of mutual concern," White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry told reporters.
Gore has been scheduled to visit Beijing to discuss plans for a summit expected later this year between President Bill Clinton and President Jiang Zemin.
McCurry said Gore, who departs on next Saturday, will visit Japan on March 23 and 24, China from March 24 to 28 and South Korea on March 28 and 29.
Relations between Washington and Beijing have taken on added importance in U.S. foreign policy. House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingrich plans to visit China in April.
